newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australian tyre firm buys 1,000T of TSR20 rubber.
newsitem.headline: Australian tyre firm buys 1,000T of TSR20 rubber.

text.p: An Australian tyre company bought on Thursday about 1,000 tonnes of TSR20 grade rubber for nearby shipment in otherwise light dealings in the Singapore rubber market, dealers said.
"The Australian company bought its monthly allotment of 1,000 tonnes of TSR20 rubber," a dealer said, adding the price ranged around 154.50-155.50 Singapore cents a kg.

"There was not much volume today except for some spot deals done for the other rubber grades. Dealings were a bit thin," another dealer said. Sentiment was weighed down by a holiday in Indonesia which offset the higher close of the Tokyo market.
"It was largely quiet today. We might see more action tomorrow especially with the way the yen is trading against the dollar," a dealer said.
The only other feature in the market was the news of sales by Malaysia of SMR20 rubber to customers in Europe and Asia, traders said.

At 0945 GMT, June RSS3 rubber was seen at 113.00 U.S. cents a kg from 114.00 cents last Tuesday. June RSS1 was seen at 161.00 Singapore cents (US$1.12) a kg from 162.50 cents. July TSR20 was seen at 154.75 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg from 156.25 cents.
